context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 tested AI-powered allocation analysis. The GET /api/portfolio/allocation-analysis endpoint uses OpenAI gpt-4o-mini to estimate underlying MF holdings and compute true sector/company exposure. Results are cached for 6 hours in allocation_analysis_cache collection. The endpoint uses a restricted projection to exclude PII - only name, ticker, asset_type, quantity, current_price, sector are sent to OpenAI. Frontend auto-fetches when Overexposure tab loads. The section shows concentration flags as amber warning banners, two-column layout with sector bar chart and numbered company list, HDFC Bank in red (>10%), and data quality note showing estimated funds count.
